svg.title: Phone: XHTTP h2/TLS packet-up vs stream-up, host CPU per GiB — lower is better
svg.desc: Small multiples of host CPU, ms/GiB per protocol for download and upload with 1 and 4 flows on a OnePlus 15. Values are in data/protocols-xhttp-cpu.csv.
svg.text: Phone: XHTTP h2/TLS packet-up vs stream-up, host CPU per GiB — lower is better
OnePlus 15 (SM8850), Android 17 · 2026-11-01 · loopback, CPU-bound · Go Xray v26.10.21 server on the phone · xray-rust profile
Mobile, TUN MTU 1500 · median of 3 runs with min–max
XHTTP mode auto = packet-up over TLS; packet-up upload is capped near 31.8 MiB/s per flow by scMaxEachPostBytes 1 MB /
scMinPostsIntervalMs 30. Label: median and change vs VLESS raw.

g.title: VLESS raw download ×1: median 7,280 ms/GiB (min 7,250 – max 7,340), n=3
XHTTP h2 packet-up download ×1: median 11,110 ms/GiB (min 10,980 – max 11,160), n=3, +53% vs VLESS raw
XHTTP h2 stream-up download ×1: median 10,760 ms/GiB (min 10,700 – max 10,790), n=3, +48% vs VLESS raw
VLESS raw download ×4: median 9,690 ms/GiB (min 9,580 – max 10,310), n=3
XHTTP h2 packet-up download ×4: median 14,470 ms/GiB (min 14,230 – max 15,010), n=3, +49% vs VLESS raw
XHTTP h2 stream-up download ×4: median 14,770 ms/GiB (min 14,750 – max 14,830), n=3, +52% vs VLESS raw
VLESS raw upload ×1: median 6,730 ms/GiB (min 6,700 – max 6,910), n=3
XHTTP h2 packet-up upload ×1: median 20,400 ms/GiB (min 20,330 – max 20,400), n=3, +203% vs VLESS raw
XHTTP h2 stream-up upload ×1: median 10,040 ms/GiB (min 9,900 – max 10,050), n=3, +49% vs VLESS raw
VLESS raw upload ×4: median 5,190 ms/GiB (min 5,080 – max 5,350), n=3
XHTTP h2 packet-up upload ×4: median 9,490 ms/GiB (min 9,300 – max 9,880), n=3, +83% vs VLESS raw
XHTTP h2 stream-up upload ×4: median 7,840 ms/GiB (min 7,760 – max 7,860), n=3, +51% vs VLESS raw

svg.text: Source: data/xhttp; devicehost VpnService (fd backend): adb-shell nc → tun0 → xray-rust → 127.0.0.1 Go Xray → loopback sink; fresh
process per config, round-robin. Host CPU = utime+stime of the devicehost process; Go server CPU excluded.
xray-rust unreleased integration build 86c79d71 (upstream fbc0e49f + PRs #112 #115 #124 #126–#130) + devicehost bench patch. Values are in
